title: MIDST Models
summary: Reference implementations for the MIDST Challenge (SaTML 2025), which evaluates membership inference attacks against diffusion-model-generated synthetic tabular data (TabDDPM, ClavaDDPM, TabSyn). The pipelines use SDV's metadata classes and evaluate_quality functions, plus standalone sdmetrics detection and quality reports, to score the fidelity of the generated synthetic tables.
evidence: gen_multi_report.py:10-12 imports evaluate_quality and SingleTableMetadata from sdv; eval_detection.py imports LogisticDetection from sdmetrics
needs: Confirm whether evaluate_quality calls run in the main benchmarking pipeline or only in an ancillary report script.
